definitions.gloss: fur, pelt, animal skin with fur
definitions.explanation: The skin of an animal with fur still attached, used especially for clothing or decoration.

notes:
{毛皮|けがわ} refers to the skin of an animal with the fur still attached, used as material for clothing and accessories.

WORD FORMATION:
⟦{毛|け}→毛：01392_ke⟧ (hair, fur) + ⟦{皮|かわ}→皮：02187_kawa⟧ (skin).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {毛皮|けがわ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦コート→コート：01358_kooto⟧: fur coat
- {毛皮|けがわ}⟦{製品|せいひん}→製品：01445_seihin⟧: fur products
- ⟦{本|ほん}→本：noentry⟧{毛皮|けがわ}: real fur
- ⟦フェイクファー→フェイクファー：noentry⟧ / ⟦{人工|じんこう}→人工：11573_jinkou⟧{毛皮|けがわ}: fake/artificial fur
- {毛皮|けがわ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{手袋|てぶくろ}→手袋：01063_tebukuro⟧: fur gloves

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{皮|かわ}→皮：02187_kawa⟧: skin, hide (with or without fur)
- ⟦{革|かわ}→革：19310_kawa⟧: processed/tanned leather
- ⟦{毛|け}→毛：01392_ke⟧: hair, fur (on the living animal)
- ⟦ファー→ファー：noentry⟧: fur (loanword, often for fashion contexts)

CULTURAL NOTE:
{毛皮|けがわ} has become a sensitive topic due to animal rights awareness. Many brands now promote ⟦フェイクファー→フェイクファー：noentry⟧ or ⟦{人工|じんこう}→人工：11573_jinkou⟧{毛皮|けがわ} as alternatives.
